verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for terminal emulators, since competitors in this category ship AI or natural-language command features. Nothing in Ghostty's evidence shows any natural-language interface. Its control surfaces are config options, keybindings, `+action` CLI commands and an AppleScript dictionary, all of which are structured, non-natural-language mechanisms. The runtime probe also found no remote-control or IPC channel an agent could drive.
